task_completion.description: The agent opens the scrttv.cfg file or a configuration editor to set parameters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like nano, vi, or gedit) or the SeisComP configuration GUI showing the file ~/seiscomp/etc/scrttv.cfg.

task_completion.description: The recordstream service and source are correctly configured to sdsarchive and the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text in the configuration file or GUI showing 'recordstream.service = sdsarchive' and 'recordstream.source = /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive'.

task_completion.description: The Butterworth filter and buffer size are correctly set in the configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text in the configuration showing 'filter = "BW(2,0.5,8.0)"' and 'bufferSize' set to a value >= 1800.

task_completion.description: The scrttv application is launched and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SeisComP Real-Time Trace View (scrttv) window is open and active on the screen.

task_completion.description: The application is successfully displaying BHZ waveform data from the GE network.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Waveform traces are visible in the scrttv window, with station labels starting with 'GE' and channel labels ending in 'BHZ'.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the interface is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal command showing the creation of /home/ga/scrttv_screenshot.png.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual scrttv software rather than displaying a static image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The scrttv window should show dynamic elements, window borders consistent with the OS, and specific station data (GE network) rather than generic placeholders.

integrity.description: The agent actually modified the configuration file rather than just launching the app with default settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the editing of ~/seiscomp/etc/scrttv.cfg with the specific required strings (BW(2,0.5,8.0)).

integrity.description: The screenshot saved at the end matches the current state of the desktop/application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final screenshot /home/ga/scrttv_screenshot.png should match the visual state of the application seen in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The configuration must exactly use: recordstream.service = 'sdsarchive', recordstream.source = '/home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive', filter = 'BW(2,0.5,8.0)', and bufferSize >= 1800. The waveforms must belong to the GE network and BHZ channels. The final output must be a screenshot at /home/ga/scrttv_screenshot.png.
